sideB.text:
DISPERSAL

Move 3 Supply cubes from one haven into one or more locations on the grid.

Play at any time. Not an action.
sideB.footer: Play at any time. Not an action.

mechanics.whenRead: Taken with the other new Rationed Events when 01-07 is read, at the end of the first January game. Kept in the reserve and added to the Rationed Event pool.
rules: Move 3 Supply cubes from one haven into one or more locations on the grid.
Play at any time. Not an action.
Move 3 Supply cubes from a single haven into one or more grid locations. The destinations may be split.
mechanics.notes: Side A is the shared rationed-event back (haven in a signal ring, yellow bars, red arc). No printed card code and no rules text. The screen title is DISPERSAL.
